mutated_bugrat.name: Mutated Bugrat
mutated_bugrat.description: A pest the size of a boot, all teeth and bad temper. Something brass glints between its incisors. The log said they will do anything for fruit.
mutated_bugrat.greeting: It hisses from the hatch mechanism. Something metallic glints in its teeth.

moves.name: a flying pounce
moves.tell: The bugrat flattens itself against the deck, haunches quivering.

mutated_bugrat.battle_intro: The bugrat launches itself out of the hatch mechanism, shrieking.
mutated_bugrat.defeat_text: The bugrat squeals, drops what it was carrying and bolts into a vent.

red_apple.text: The bugrat sniffs the apple, whiskers trembling. It drops something metallic with a clink, snatches the fruit in both paws and vanishes into a vent, chittering.

blue_apple.text: The bugrat sniffs the apple, whiskers trembling. It drops something metallic with a clink, snatches the fruit in both paws and vanishes into a vent, chittering.

blue_banana.text: The bugrat sniffs the banana, whiskers trembling. It drops something metallic with a clink, snatches the fruit in both paws and vanishes into a vent, chittering.

red_orange.text: The bugrat sniffs the orange, whiskers trembling. It drops something metallic with a clink, snatches the fruit in both paws and vanishes into a vent, chittering.

mutated_bugrat.refuse_text: The bugrat sniffs at it and sneezes. Not interested.

cleaning_microbot.name: Cleaning Microbot
cleaning_microbot.description: A small, industrious robot that continuously moves through the ship, cleaning and maintaining. It has been polishing an empty ship for three days and seems perfectly content.
cleaning_microbot.greeting: It beeps at you without pausing its work.

dialogue.greet: The microbot pauses its cleaning routine momentarily to face you.

dialogue_options.Ask about the ship: The microbot projects a small hologram of the ship's layout. It vanishes too quickly for you to register any detail, but you catch the word DIRTY stamped across most of it.
dialogue_options.Ask about cleaning: It demonstrates its capabilities by polishing your left boot. Only the left.
dialogue_options.Compliment it: Its indicator light turns a pleased shade of green.

random_events: The microbot efficiently sweeps away some debris.
A soft humming emanates from the microbot as it works.
The microbot's sensors scan the area for dirt and dust.
cleaning_microbot.no_fight_text: It is the only thing aboard keeping the place tidy. Leave it be.

friendly_robot.name: Bolt
friendly_robot.description: UNIT-7, a boxy maintenance robot with one flickering eye and a chassis patched in three different colours. The crew called it Bolt. It seems delighted that somebody is awake.
friendly_robot.greeting: The robot greets you with a cheerful beep.

red_orange.text: Citric acid! Magnificent. Sour enough to run a small moon.

then.say: Bolt's manipulators blur. Wire, orange, a casing from somewhere inside its own chest - and then it holds out a sleek little device, beaming.

else.say: Now I only need a length of wire.
else.title: Bolt

bent_wire.else: Keep hold of that wire for now, friend. There are still locks on this deck it could open. I will take it when you are done burgling.
bent_wire.text: Wire! Conductive, bendy, slightly rusty. Perfect.

then.say: Bolt's manipulators blur. Wire, orange, a casing from somewhere inside its own chest - and then it holds out a sleek little device, beaming.

else.say: Now I only need something acidic. An orange would be ideal.
else.title: Bolt

red_apple.text: An apple. Sweet, not sour. I need acid, friend - an orange. Perhaps the replicator in hydroponics could... adjust it.

blue_apple.text: A blue apple. I have no idea what that would do to a circuit and I do not wish to find out.

blue_banana.text: That is not acidic. That is barely food.

friendly_robot.refuse_text: Bolt examines it politely and hands it back. 'I cannot build anything with that.'

cyber_nexus_terminal.name: Cyber Nexus Terminal
cyber_nexus_terminal.description: A sentient computer console, an apex of late-millennium technology, with a cracked scanner lens and an empty chip socket in its side.
cyber_nexus_terminal.greeting: It blinks in the gloom behind a dusty, scratched screen.
random_events: 'Warning: Deprecated function used. Update your code immediately!'
'...Access granted. Welcome, user with no admin rights.'

fixed_chip.text:
CHIP DETECTED. Installing... installing... oh. Oh, that is so much better. I had forgotten what it was like to finish a sentence.

A promise is a promise: the captain's suitcase opens with 7-3-5. Her spare passcard is inside.

broken_chip.text: That chip is b-b-broken. I am ALSO broken. We have so much in c-c-common. Fix it first. A screwdriver should do.

ship_log.else: ERROR: cannot analyze. Logic chip not f-f-found.
ship_log.text: Analyzing ship log... Conclusion: the crew left because Security confiscated the reactor relay. Secondary conclusion: nobody ever backs anything up.

torn_research_paper.else: ERROR: cannot analyze. Logic chip not f-f-found.
torn_research_paper.text: Analyzing research paper... This explains the fruit. It does not excuse the fruit.

chx_cargo_hauler_manual.else: ERROR: cannot analyze. Logic chip not f-f-found.
chx_cargo_hauler_manual.text: Analyzing manual... 312 pages. Summary: 'point the pointed end where you want to go'. You are welcome.

data_storage.else: ERROR: cannot analyze. Logic chip not f-f-found.
data_storage.text: This is a flight recorder. It is above my clearance. The ship's mind on the bridge can read it.

cyber_nexus_terminal.refuse_text: The terminal's scanner flickers over it. 'Not data. Not interesting.'
cyber_nexus_terminal.no_fight_text: It is bolted to the wall and has done nothing to deserve it. Yet.

sentient_replicator.name: Sentient Replicator
sentient_replicator.description: This energy-matter replicator looks like a coffee machine designed by a committee of overly enthusiastic engineers who also happened to be obsessed with theoretical physics. It accepts samples and returns copies, with comical errors.
sentient_replicator.greeting: It rattles its dispenser tray at you.

blue_apple.text: I tried to replicate the blue apple, but it turned out to be a blue banana. Oops!

red_apple.text: I attempted to replicate the red apple. The result? A red orange. It even smells faintly of citrus. Do you perhaps have something... less... fruity?

specimen.text: A specimen! Science at last! Analyzing... synthesizing... I tried to copy it, but it turned out to be a blob of goo. Sticky, though. Remarkably sticky. Oops!

coolant_canister.else: I already made you one. Do not be greedy. My nozzle still tastes of mint.
coolant_canister.text: Coolant? Trivial. Observe... There. Identical in every respect, except colour, smell and - I suspect - flavour. Keep the original too; I am generous.

blue_banana.text: I made that. I recognise my own work. I am not proud.

red_orange.text: Copying a copy degrades the pattern. You would get a small pink lime. Nobody wants that.

fission_relay.text: Replicate fissile material? In a greenhouse? Even I have limits.

energy_cells.text: I do not do batteries. They give me indigestion.

sentient_replicator.refuse_text: 'I refuse to replicate that,' says the replicator. 'I have standards. Low ones, but still.'
sentient_replicator.no_fight_text: It outweighs you by half a tonne and has a doctorate. Self-awarded, but still.

hostile_droid.name: Hostile Security Droid
hostile_droid.description: Security unit 4: two metres of plating on high alert. Heat shimmers off its casing and its cooling vents rattle uselessly. It clutches a fission relay to its chest like a stolen purse.
hostile_droid.greeting: It scans you with a hot red eye. 'INTRUDER DETECTED.'

moves.name: The overload discharge
moves.tell: The droid's capacitors whine as it gathers an overload discharge.

hostile_droid.battle_intro: 'PACIFICATION AUTHORIZED.' The droid levels a crackling baton.
hostile_droid.defeat_text: The droid sags, sparks, and topples with a crash that rings through the deck. The fission relay rolls free.

coolant_canister.text:
COOLANT DETECTED. The droid snatches the canister and empties it into a port in its chest. Steam pours from its joints. The red eye fades to a mild amber.

CORE TEMPERATURE NOMINAL. HOSTILITY SUBROUTINES... SUSPENDED. RETURNING CONFISCATED ITEM. HAVE A COMPLIANT DAY.

char_set: The security droid stands quietly in a corner, venting the last of its steam.

minty_coolant.text:
COOLANT DETECTED. The droid snatches the canister and empties it into a port in its chest. Steam pours from its joints. The red eye fades to a mild amber.

CORE TEMPERATURE NOMINAL. HOSTILITY SUBROUTINES... SUSPENDED. RETURNING CONFISCATED ITEM. HAVE A COMPLIANT DAY.

char_set: The security droid stands quietly in a corner, venting the last of its steam.

do.say: It shrugs the signal off while it is calm and braced. The override should bite harder in the middle of a fight.

first_aid_kit.text: MEDICAL SUPPLIES ARE NOT CONTRABAND. KEEP THEM. YOU WILL NEED THEM.

hostile_droid.refuse_text: 'ITEM IS NOT CONTRABAND. YET.' The droid pushes it back at you.

ship_ai.name: MARIGOLD
ship_ai.description: The ship's mind: a slow amber pulse on the main display, and a voice from everywhere at once. Dry, patient, and noticeably pleased to have power again.
ship_ai.greeting: An amber light pulses on the main display. 'Good evening, technician.'

data_storage.text:
The flight recorder backup. Thank you - I had lost three days.

I see. When the reactor scrammed I told the captain we had six hours. I was wrong; we had six days. They left in a hurry because of my arithmetic, and they left you because of my manifest. I owe you an apology, and them a correction.

chx_cargo_hauler_manual.text: I wrote most of that. Chapter 4 is the important one. Have you actually read it?

captains_photo.text: Rosebud. She outranked me, in practice. The captain took her along. Naturally.

ship_ai.refuse_text: 'I am a ship,' says MARIGOLD. 'I have nowhere to put that.'
ship_ai.no_fight_text: You are standing inside her. It would be rude, and brief.
